ns2:section.sectionText: An introduction to the molecular and cell biology and biomechanics of animal development. The goal of this course is to introduce students to the molecular and cell biology and biomechanics of animal development. Specifically, it will apply the principles of solid mechanics to understanding events in tissue and organ morphogenesis including gastrulation, cardiac looping, and brain folding. Prereqs: basic knowledge of molecular biology and genetics; MCB 410 or equivalent; calculus; physics (mechanics); or consent of instructor Credit: 1 hour
